guard_rules: setopt pipefail in the executing shell; guard/put rc captured explicitly (g=$?), never via a pipe tail
rboot timer starts before target boot; a timed-out target boot is judged read-only, never resent

restore_branches: before M1 or M1 partial: baseline env then expected; R4-style verify if a reboot happened
after R1, before C1: baseline env + expected (not maint-reverse) -> reboot -> verify
C1 partial/done before C2 (never enabled): under recorded R1 isolation, B1 bodies -> baseline env+expected last -> reboot -> verify
C2 partial (enabled env written, expected not yet / incomplete): treat as NOT disabled -> M2 maint-reverse env+expected, readback match -> R3 isolation -> B1 -> B2 -> R4
C2 done / R2 or later: M2 -> R3 isolation -> B1 -> B2 -> R4
M2 written/partial: finish M2 + readback; R3 must complete with isolation before B1
B1/B2 partial: continue only if R3 isolation recorded; else back to M2 branch
unknown/lost receipt: read-only readback only; never guess or resend
stop_rules: any stop marker present -> stop, keep lock, report; never clear
budget below phase+full restore -> enter restore now
boot wait timeout -> read-only judgement, no resend
body error with rc0 -> treat as failure

no .new temps; stage/backup listed with identity and reason
